newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strike continues to halt Swissair cargo at CDG.
newsitem.headline: Strike continues to halt Swissair cargo at CDG.

text.p: Swissair's cargo activities at Paris-Charles de Gaulle are likely to be hit for a third consecutive day tomorrow as a result of strike action by staff protesting at plans to cut jobs, a CDG-based cargo official told Reuters.

"With the exception of some valuable shipments there has been no freight leaving from or arriving at Swissair's installations at CDG today and the reports we have received suggest that strike action will continue tomorrow," the official said
Swissair normally operates three trucking rotations daily between Paris and Zurich, Geneva and Basle.
The Swiss airline also carries freight - mostly valuables and perishables - on passenger services to Zurich and Geneva from Paris.
"Passenger services are operating near-normally," the official added.

The dispute centres on Swissair's French restructuring programme which involves cutting 66 jobs, including around 25 staff in cargo handling operations, which will be outsourced from January 1 1997. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
